mechanism: Both agents have cardiovascular effects; guanfacine is an alpha-2 agonist causing bradycardia and hypotension while flecainide is a Class IC antiarrhythmic with negative inotropic properties and potential to cause conduction delays, creating additive cardiac effects.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and ECG parameters closely; consider alternative antiarrhythmic if guanfacine cannot be discontinued; dose adjustment may be necessary.
